name: @openclinxr/station-mouth-verifier
purpose: Shared mouth-station verifier: headless scene posing, runtime drive, capture projection, premise probe and the ground-truth dy gate.

exportSummaries.CueTrackCue: One cue in the fixed-capture cue track the evaluator drives.
exportSummaries.DY_GATE_RULE: Gate rule tag recorded on failure.
exportSummaries.EvaluateParams: Evaluator drive options for sensitivity probes.
exportSummaries.EvaluatorOutput: Full evaluator output: provenance, camera, per-frame records and summary.
exportSummaries.EvaluatorSummary: Aggregate evaluator summary: gap stats, ground-truth gates and rim stats.
exportSummaries.EvaluatorTrack: Evaluator cue track: the fixed-capture line plus samples.
exportSummaries.FrameRecord: Per-frame evaluator record: measured geometry plus projection errors.
exportSummaries.HeadFocusCamera: Head-focus camera: perspective camera plus the head box it frames.
exportSummaries.HeadlessMesh: One skinned mesh rebuilt headlessly: base positions plus skinning tables.
exportSummaries.HeadlessScene: Headless scene: root group plus body/teeth meshes and head/jaw bones.
exportSummaries.NowGapPoint: One trailing-word gap point in the evaluator summary.
exportSummaries.PositionSpace: Position spaces named on every position field.
exportSummaries.PremiseProbeRow: One premise-probe row: static morph response at a viseme's runtime jaw angle.
exportSummaries.ToothSample: One ground-truth tooth centroid sample from the step3 capture.
exportSummaries.assertGroundTruthDyGate: Assert the bias-aware dy ground-truth gate.
exportSummaries.evaluate: Drive the loaded scene through the runtime's prepared-audio path and measure per-frame teeth/lip geometry.
exportSummaries.headFocusCamera: The isolated-subject head-focus camera for this asset.
exportSummaries.loadHeadlessScene: Load the parent GLB into a headless scene with body/teeth meshes and head/jaw bones.
exportSummaries.probePremise: One-minute premise probe: static morph response per viseme at its runtime jaw angle.
exportSummaries.readEvaluatorTrack: Read and validate an evaluator track file.
